description: Utility functions for constructing filter form data and formatting data record values in the Superset frontend.

methods.name: getSelectExtraFormData
methods.description: Constructs ExtraFormData for select filters, handling empty filters and inclusion/exclusion of values.

methods.name: getRangeExtraFormData
methods.description: Creates filter clauses for range filters based on lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: getDataRecordFormatter
methods.description: Returns a function to format data record values based on type, with optional time and number formatters.
